findings.description: storage_encrypted is set to false, so RDS data is stored unencrypted at rest, exposing confidential database content if the underlying storage is compromised.
publicly_accessible is set to true, exposing the RDS database directly to the internet rather than keeping it in a private subnet, greatly expanding its attack surface.

The RDS password is set to var.password directly and the same password variable is embedded in plain text within the EC2 user_data script, making the credential readable by anyone with describe access on the resources and stored in plain text.
The policy grants s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* on Resource "*", giving the EC2 role effectively administrative access across the account and violating least privilege.
The egress rule allows all protocols and all ports to 0.0.0.0/0, providing an unrestricted outbound path that permits data exfiltration and command-and-control channels.
